quoted_tweet.text:
Lacson questions Zaldy Co's budget insertion 'kwento': If it's true, why did Marcos veto it?

Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson isn't buying yet former Ako Bicol party-list Rep. Zaldy Co's latest allegations about President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s P100-billion insertion in the 2025 national budget.

Lacson encouraged Co to come home and testify under oath, saying that his remarks were all just "kwento" or narration for now.

Lacson, in a media interview on Friday,  also raised questions about Co's statement about the budget insertion. He said since Marcos already had full control over the National Expenditure Program, there would be no reason to insert it in the bicameral budget. And if Co's claim about insertion was true, he asked why Marcos eventually veto such allocations.

Video courtesy: Abante Radyo
